starter_files.contents:
# Multi-Vendor Commerce Management Platform

## Objective
Build a production-oriented Angular frontend for customer, supplier and administrative commerce workflows, backed by a trusted API.

## Requirements
- [ ] Product catalogue, search and product details
- [ ] Cart, checkout UI, account and order pages
- [ ] Supplier product management and order-processing screens
- [ ] Role-aware navigation with backend authorization
- [ ] Tests, responsive accessible UI, performance and production delivery docs

## Run and verify
- Pin a compatible Angular / Node.js version.
- Run `npm ci` after producing a reviewed package lock.
- Run `ng serve`, the configured test command and `ng build`.
- Record exact versions, output and known limitations.

required_features: Product catalogue, search and product details
Cart, checkout UI, account and order pages
Supplier product management and order-processing screens
Tests, responsive accessible UI, performance and production delivery docs
stretch_features: Add an additional focused test for a realistic failure mode.
Measure one quality attribute and document how it was measured.
Add a short architecture decision record for a meaningful trade-off.
test_plan: Verify an empty, invalid or failed-network state.
Test important component/service behavior with the project test runner.
Review keyboard access, labels, focus visibility and reduced-motion behavior.
Run the configured production build and capture the actual result.

rubric.criterion: Reproducible setup, documentation and delivery evidence

review_method: Human-reviewed project with static structure checks and learner-provided tests/evidence. Do not treat a source token scan as proof of runtime correctness; actual deployment and backend security must be tested independently.
status_note: Project brief and solution outline are draft. No runtime execution or deployment is claimed.
